member.name: T:SysWeaver.Serialization.NetJsonSerializer
member.summary: Serializer for the "json" extension using System.Text.Json. Always registered by (priority 0), so it is the fallback JSON implementation.
member.remarks: Public fields are included, read-only fields and get-only properties are ignored. NaN and Infinity are written and accepted as named literals ("NaN", "Infinity"). When reading, trailing commas are allowed and comments are skipped. produces indented output, is the same as ; no type information is ever written. Output uses , so HTML sensitive characters (< > & ') and non-ASCII characters are NOT escaped, the output must be escaped before it is embedded in HTML.

member.name: T:SysWeaver.Serialization.NetXmlSerializer
member.summary: Serializer for the "xml" extension using . Not registered by default, call to make it available.
member.remarks: The usual restrictions apply: types must be public with a public parameterless constructor and only public read/write members are serialized. member.name: T:SysWeaver.Serialization.SerializerOptions

member.name: T:SysWeaver.Serialization.SerManager
member.summary: Process wide registry of serializer implementations, keyed by file extension (with and without a leading dot).
member.remarks: is always registered (by the static constructor). Other serializers are added by calling their static Register method (or by listing them in a service manifest). When several serializers share an extension, lookups return the one with the highest , on a tie the last registered one.
